rounds.q: A football field is 100 yards long. How many feet wide is it?
rounds.why: That is 53 1/3 yards. Counting both end zones, the field is 360 feet long.
rounds.src: NFL Rulebook, Rule 1 Section 1 (current rulebook, read Nov 2026)
rounds.fun: 160 feet wide and 360 feet long with the end zones. Plenty of room to run!

rounds.q: How many feet long is the Statue of Liberty's index finger?
rounds.why: Her nose is 4 feet 6 inches long, and she stands 305 feet from ground to torch.
rounds.src: National Park Service, Statue of Liberty statistics
rounds.fun: An 8-foot finger and a nose 4 feet 6 inches long. She is a big lady!

rounds.q: About how many pounds does a blue whale's heart weigh?
rounds.why: One weighed after a 2014 stranding came in at 400 to 440 pounds. It stood about 5 feet tall.
rounds.src: Guinness World Records, Largest heart (440 lb); Royal Ontario Museum lists 180 kg
rounds.fun: A heart of about 400 pounds, standing about 5 feet tall. Big love!

rounds.q: How many Earths would fit side by side across the Sun?
rounds.why: To fill the whole Sun, you would need about 1.3 million Earths.
rounds.src: Stanford Solar Center; NASA, Sun Facts
rounds.fun: 109 Earths in a row just to cross it, and 1.3 million to fill it up!

rounds.q: How many miles of wire are in the Golden Gate Bridge's two main cables?
rounds.why: Each cable is about 3 feet thick and holds 27,572 separate wires.
rounds.src: Golden Gate Bridge District, Design and Construction Statistics
rounds.fun: 80,000 miles of wire in one bridge, with 27,572 wires in each cable!
